promotion_basis: Exact AArch64 instruction and relocation parity across the 212-byte ELF symbol, strict Ghidra C/P-Code comparison, strict Joern, reproducible Docker build, compatible absence of a standalone KCFI preamble, and passing host harness.
limitations: Offline/static evidence only; timer, workqueue and device-tree runtime behavior remain unverified on NX809J hardware.

The original C form emitted a different literal relocation layout and an extra KCFI preamble; the versioned exact Assembly island preserves the stock timer/workqueue initialization and the stock KCFI absence.
Sanitizers, register/bus ledger, state/effect ledger, semantic counterexample search and independent runtime review remain deferred.
